insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Chronic Renal Failure or end stage Renal Failure
Sinusitis/Deviated Nasal Septum/Tympanoplasty/Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Critical Illness initial 90 days. Bariatric Surgery: 72 months (Supreme Plus), 48 months (Elite Plus). IVF Treatment: 48 months. PED: 24 months for Elite only.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured. Modern Treatments up to 50% of SI.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Covers Medical Practitioner fees, diagnostics, medicines, OT, ICU, IV fluids, blood, prosthetics implanted internally.

day_care_treatments.notes: Pre and post hospitalization expenses included.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to SI; 3-day minimum continuous treatment
domiciliary_treatment.notes: Pre-hospitalization expenses payable; post-hospitalization not payable.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient under Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs.2L-2.5L based on SI (Elite Plan only)
maternity_coverage.notes: 3-year (36 month) waiting period; both husband and wife covered.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: 25% of Sum Insured (Rs.6.25L-37.5L); vaccinations up to Rs.10,000 first year
newborn_coverage.notes: Maternity Benefit must be accepted. Elite Plan only.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Medical expenses for harvesting; up to SI
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Excludes pre/post hospitalization and screening expenses of donor.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.3,000 Classic / Rs.5,000 Supreme / Rs.10,000 Elite per hospitalization
ambulance_cover.notes: Surface transport to nearest hospital following emergency.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Second Opinion for 11 CIs (Supreme/Elite); International Treatment for 11 CIs (Elite); +11 more CIs under Supreme Plus/Elite Plus
critical_illness_cover.notes: Critical illness must be diagnosed in India. 20% co-payment on international treatment claims.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Re-load of Sum Insured up to 100% of Base SI
restoration_benefit.notes: For different illness or different insured for same illness. Not for 1st claim. Not for worldwide emergency hospitalization.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual (Supreme/Elite); biennial (Classic). Over and above SI for insured 18+

copayment_trigger_notes: Zone 2 is priced 25% lower than Zone 1. 20% co-payment on International Treatment for specified CIs under Elite.

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: 50% of SI or Rs.20 lakhs, whichever lower; USD 2,000 deductible per hospitalization
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Elite Plan only. US/Canada included only via separate optional cover.

permanent_exclusions: Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas (Excl13)
temporary_exclusions: Bariatric Surgery 72 months (Supreme Plus) / 48 months (Elite Plus)
notable_exclusions_summary: Lifeline excludes treatments outside India (except worldwide emergency for Elite), refractive error, unproven treatments, infertility (except IVF rider under Elite Plus), congenital external anomalies, and all forms of OPD. Maternity is excluded except under Elite Plan after 36-month waiting period.
claim_process_summary: Cashless and reimbursement both via TPA. For cashless: call TPA helpline, furnish membership number, get pre-authorization. Settlement within 15 days of last document; 2% above bank rate interest for delays.
available_riders: Top-up plan with deductible (Rs.1-10 lakhs) - Endorsement 1
US/Canada inclusion for Worldwide Hospitalization - Endorsement 3
Elite Plus (Premium add-on with IVF, 22 CI Second Opinion)
top_rider_examples: Elite Plus (IVF + Maternity + International Treatment for 14 CIs)
Supreme Plus (Bariatric Surgery + Mobility Devices + Refresh of SI)
